newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apple South started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apple South started.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Erika Gritman Long started coverage of restaurant company Apple South Inc Thursday with a rating of buy.
-- "Apple South has remade itself in 15 months, and the result should be strong, more sustainable earnings growth beginning this year," she wrote in a report.
-- She set a 12- to 18-month price target of $17. Her 1997 earnings per share estimate was $0.95 and for 1998 was $1.20.
-- Shares in the Madison, Ga., company opened unchanged at 12-1/2.
